'''Todirium III''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Todirium system/Legends|Todirium system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Located near [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Zsinj]]'s territory, it was a bleak iron [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colony that refined [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]]. [[Wraith Squadron]] [[Raid on Todirium|raided]] the planet in the guise of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] during their campaign against Zsinj.
